shared_elements: curvilinear low-relief carved motifs covering a rock surface
schematic anthropomorphic figures with large round eyes
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, outlined curvilinear carvings including concentric ring/disc motifs, crescent-like arcs and crouching big-eyed anthropomorphic creatures, and in both the motifs are cut in shallow relief and paired or mirrored about an axis, which is a fairly specific shared repertoire. The biggest difference in content is organisation: A places a small, ordered set of motifs symmetrically on the back and crown of a single monumental human figure (whose own body is the main subject), whereas B is an unbounded dense field of many independent creature designs scattered over an irregular rock, with no dominant figure.
